note: Optional submodule of Easy Encryption. Adds a UI for key transfer (list/export/import) and private-key migration. Keys list at /admin/config/system/easy-encryption/keys (route easy_encryption_admin.keys, the configure route); import (easy_encryption_admin.keys_import), export (keys_export), migrate private key (migrate_private_key). All gated by permission 'administer easy encryption keys' (restrict access). Requires easy_encryption. No config schema/Drush/plugins. Introspection reads which role has the permission; execution grants the permission to a role and ensures the module is enabled. Namespaced roles (eea_*), no node operations.

evals.prompt: The easy_encryption_admin module adds an admin UI for Easy Encryption keys. Which permission controls access to it, and at what admin path is the keys page?
evals.expected_output: The 'administer easy encryption keys' permission (restrict access) gates it. The keys list is at /admin/config/system/easy-encryption/keys (route easy_encryption_admin.keys, the module's configure route).

evals.prompt: What can you do from the easy_encryption_admin UI?
evals.expected_output: List known encryption keys with usage counts, export a key as a portable package and import a key package (key transfer, optionally activating it), and migrate the active private key from the database to the filesystem.

evals.prompt: How do I move an Easy Encryption encryption key to another site using the easy_encryption_admin UI?
evals.expected_output: On the source site, use the Export operation on the keys page to download the key package; on the target site, use the Import encryption key form (route easy_encryption_admin.keys_import) to import that package, optionally activating it. Then deploy the config with the encrypted Key entities.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site a role has been given the permission to manage Easy Encryption keys (the easy_encryption_admin keys UI). Inspect the live roles and give the machine name of the role that can administer Easy Encryption keys.
evals.expected_output: The role eea_operator has the 'administer easy encryption keys' permission.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the role eea_viewer has been granted access to the Easy Encryption keys admin UI. Inspect the live site and state the exact permission machine name that grants that access.
evals.expected_output: The permission is 'administer easy encryption keys' (granted to role eea_viewer).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a role with machine name eea_keymanager and grant it the permission that lets it use the Easy Encryption keys admin UI (import/export keys). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create Role eea_keymanager and grant it 'administer easy encryption keys' (Role::create(['id'=>'eea_keymanager',...])->grantPermission('administer easy encryption keys')->save()).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site I want to be able to import and export my encryption keys from the admin screens instead of the command line. Make sure the module that provides that Easy Encryption keys admin UI is turned on.
evals.expected_output: Enable the easy_encryption_admin module (drush en easy_encryption_admin -y). It provides the keys UI at /admin/config/system/easy-encryption/keys (route easy_encryption_admin.keys) for import/export and private-key migration.
